segments.name: Wireless
segments.description: Provides prepaid and postpaid mobile communications and fixed wireless broadband services to consumers throughout the Philippines.
segments.evidence: We provide (1) mobile services, (2) fixed wireless broadband services, and (3) other services, through our wireless business, with mobile services contributing 98 % of our 2025 wireless service revenues

segments.name: Fixed Line
segments.description: Provides fixed line data, voice and ICT services to retail, corporate and SME clients, including data center, multi-cloud, cyber security, data and AI solutions.
segments.evidence: Our Fixed Line business segment offers data, voice, and miscellaneous services.

segments.name: Others
segments.description: Holds interests in digital platforms and other technologies.
segments.evidence: Our other business consists primarily of our interests in digital platforms and other technologies, including our interests in MIH and Kayana.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for telecommunications services, including prepaid and postpaid mobile voice, SMS and data, and fixed line voice, data and ICT services, mostly prepaid subscribers.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues primarily from providing the following telecommunications services: cellular voice, SMS and data services in the wireless business; and local exchange, international and national long distance, data and other network, and information and communications services in the fixed line business.
